question: How is the act of washing the mouth reinterpreted in a higher spiritual sense?
premises: Washing of the mouth is mentioned as constant
It is described as directed upward
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is understood as directed upward toward Brahman.
uncertainties: The symbolic meaning of mouth-washing in this context is interpretive
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is directed upward toward Brahman.
